functions.name: lfs recursive walk

local lfs = require("lfs")
local sep = package.config:sub(1, 1)

local function walk(root, callback)
    for entry in lfs.dir(root) do
        if entry ~= "." and entry ~= ".." then
            local fullpath = root .. sep .. entry
            local mode = lfs.attributes(fullpath, "mode")
            callback(fullpath, mode)
            if mode == "directory" then
                walk(fullpath, callback)
            end
        end
    end
end

walk(".", function(path, mode)
    print(mode, path)
end)

local lfs = require("lfs")

local function locked_write(path, text)
    local file, err = io.open(path, "a")
    if not file then
        return nil, err
    end
    local ok, lockErr = lfs.lock(file, "w")
    if not ok then
        file:close()
        return nil, lockErr
    end
    file:write(text)
    file:write("\n")
    lfs.unlock(file)
    file:close()
    return true
end

functions.name: visualiser une rotation
functions.insertText:
local rotation = 0

function onTick()
    rotation = input.getNumber(1)
end

local function rotatePoint(cx, cy, angle, px, py)
    local s, c = math.sin(angle), math.cos(angle)
    px, py = px - cx, py - cy
    return { x = px * c - py * s + cx, y = px * s + py * c + cy }
end

function onDraw()
    local cx, cy, r = 10, 10, 8
    local angle = rotation * math.pi * 2
    local p = rotatePoint(cx, cy, angle, cx, cy - r)
    screen.setColor(0, 0, 255)
    screen.drawCircle(cx, cy, r)
    screen.setColor(255, 0, 0)
    screen.drawLine(cx, cy, p.x, p.y)
end

functions.signature: counter = counter + 1 ; if counter >= wait_ticks then ... end
functions.insertText:
local counter = 0
local WAIT_TICKS = 30

function onTick()
    counter = counter + 1
    if counter >= WAIT_TICKS then
        counter = 0
        -- action périodique
    end
end
